name: Supervisory Committee Meeting
description: Document credit union supervisory committee meetings including audit findings, compliance reviews, internal controls assessments, and member complaint reviews.

sections.title: Meeting Overview
sections.instruction: Summarize the meeting purpose, the credit union name, and any specific focus areas for this session (e.g., annual audit review, internal controls, exam follow-up).

sections.title: Attendees & Quorum
sections.instruction: List supervisory committee members present, staff attendees, and any external auditors or guests. Note whether quorum was established.

sections.title: Agenda Items
sections.instruction: List the agenda items covered during the meeting.

sections.title: Audit & Exam Findings
sections.instruction: Summarize findings from internal audits, external audits, or regulatory examinations reviewed during the meeting. Include finding severity and any management responses.

sections.title: Internal Controls Review
sections.instruction: Summarize the committee's review of internal controls, segregation of duties, fraud risk areas, or any control gaps identified or remediated.

sections.title: Compliance & Regulatory Items
sections.instruction: List any compliance matters discussed, including BSA/AML, NCUA requirements, state regulations, or upcoming regulatory changes.

sections.title: Member Complaints & Escalations
sections.instruction: Summarize any member complaints or escalations reviewed by the committee. Note resolution status and any systemic issues identified.

sections.title: Motions & Votes
sections.instruction: Document any formal motions made, who moved and seconded them, and the vote outcome.

sections.title: Action Items & Follow-Up
sections.instruction: List all corrective actions, follow-up tasks, and items to be reported to the board. Include owners and due dates.
